notes.declined: The user declined. Don't ask for it in chat or another way; say what's blocked and go on without it.
notes.cancelled: The card closed with the run. Ask again with a new clientRequestId only if the secret is still needed.
notes.timed_out: No answer in time. Don't ask in chat; ask again with a new clientRequestId only if it is still needed.

errors.load_failed: Could not load the secret request.
errors.not_found: This secret request no longer exists.
errors.already_answered: This secret request was already answered.
errors.agent_stopped: The agent that asked has stopped, so this secret can't be used.
errors.reference_unreadable: Could not read the secret from the secret provider.
errors.record_failed: Saved the secret, but could not update the request.
errors.ref_unavailable: That secretRef was already used or does not exist. Ask the user again with request_secret.
errors.ref_expired: That secretRef expired. Ask the user again with request_secret.
errors.consume_failed: Could not use that secretRef. Try again.
errors.not_a_file_request: The user did not save this secret for shell use. Ask again with request_secret and delivery: "file".
